steps.milestone: Analyze the dual generator encryption and per-character reseeding
steps.outcome: Each message bit selects one generator, followed by hidden reseeding outputs.
steps.evidence_quote: We have 2 LCGs, each with 128-bit parameters (mod, mult, add, seed)

steps.milestone: Recognize that generator moduli shrink after every character
steps.outcome: Each new modulus is an output below the previous modulus.
steps.evidence_quote: So the mod values are strictly decreasing! (Or at least non-increasing)

steps.milestone: Recover the first generator parameters from known prefix outputs
steps.outcome: The first generator parameters were recovered and used to derive later states.
steps.evidence_quote: Great! We recovered the first lcg1 parameters!

steps.milestone: Search printable characters using an incorrect generator advancement model
steps.outcome: The candidate search reached no possibilities at the next unknown character.
steps.evidence_quote: The search failed at char 6 (no candidates).

steps.milestone: Correct generator advancement and continue character recovery
steps.outcome: Corrected simulation identified the first two unknown plaintext characters.

steps.milestone: Select the format-consistent candidate and print the recovered flag
steps.outcome: The complete flag was printed by the final verification script.
